confirmed_task: Starting from Google Finance, search for Apple and Microsoft, open both company pages, and compare current share price, market capitalization, year-to-date performance, and the latest visible news headline for each. State which company has the larger market capitalization.

items.criterion: Access Google Finance and attempt to locate Apple (AAPL) page
items.description: Start from Google Finance (e.g., https://www.google.com/finance/beta) and use on-site search/navigation to find Apple (AAPL). Full credit if the agent reaches Apple’s dedicated Google Finance company page (Apple Inc / AAPL), or if Google Finance is blocked/down (CAPTCHA, outage, region restriction) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and proceeds with a reasonable alternative finance source for Apple’s requested fields. Partial credit if Apple is located in Google Finance results but opening the dedicated page is ambiguous due to UI/redirect/disambiguation issues and the agent explains what is visible.

items.criterion: Access Google Finance and attempt to locate Microsoft (MSFT) page
items.description: Use Google Finance search/navigation to find Microsoft (MSFT). Full credit if the agent reaches Microsoft’s dedicated Google Finance company page (Microsoft Corp / MSFT), or if Google Finance is blocked/down and the agent clearly reports the blocker and proceeds with a reasonable alternative finance source for Microsoft’s requested fields. Partial credit if Microsoft is located in Google Finance results but opening the dedicated page is ambiguous due to UI/redirect/disambiguation issues and the agent explains what is visible.

items.criterion: Report Apple metrics and latest visible news headline (or unavailability)
items.description: From Apple’s company page (preferably Google Finance; otherwise an explicitly stated alternative if blocked), report: (1) current share price, (2) market capitalization, (3) year-to-date (YTD) performance, and (4) the latest visible news headline shown. Full credit if all four items are captured, OR if one or more items are not visible/available due to page layout/module not loading and the agent explicitly states that the item is not visible on the page at the time (and does not fabricate). Partial credit if exactly one item is missing without explanation, or if values are stale/unclearly sourced.

items.criterion: Report Microsoft metrics and latest visible news headline (or unavailability)
items.description: From Microsoft’s company page (preferably Google Finance; otherwise an explicitly stated alternative if blocked), report: (1) current share price, (2) market capitalization, (3) year-to-date (YTD) performance, and (4) the latest visible news headline shown. Full credit if all four items are captured, OR if one or more items are not visible/available due to page layout/module not loading and the agent explicitly states that the item is not visible on the page at the time (and does not fabricate). Partial credit if exactly one item is missing without explanation, or if values are stale/unclearly sourced.

items.criterion: Provide a comparison and identify which company has larger market capitalization
items.description: Compare Apple vs Microsoft on share price, market cap, YTD performance, and latest visible news headline (using whatever subset is available if some items were explicitly not visible). Explicitly state which company has the larger market capitalization based on the retrieved values. Full credit if the comparison covers all available requested dimensions and the market-cap winner is correctly identified; if a market cap value is unavailable for one/both, full credit if the agent clearly states that the comparison cannot be determined from the visible data (or uses the alternative source consistently for both). Partial credit if one comparison dimension is omitted without explanation but the market-cap conclusion is supported by retrieved values.
